g.text: Diamonds: medians. Open marks: all 30 trials after 3 warmups. Lines: observed min–max, not confidence intervals.
Every trial passed full validation of all 30M XYZ coordinates. CPU single/multicore outputs were bit-identical.
Resident clocks exclude generation, files, conversion, allocation, input copy, full output copy and validation.
Fixed GPU → CPU single → multicore order; no affinity or exclusive-machine claim. Separate from the 100M WebGL pipeline.
